name: Circle of the Forged Spells
description:
When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of the Forge Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

Level 3: Blade Ward, Identify, Mirror Image

Level 5: Haste

Level 7: Fire Shield

Level 9: Animate Objects
